title: PVP/FFA Plugin
description: FFA and PVP Plugin for paper 1.21.8
body:
### **Ultimate FFA & 1v1 PvP System**

Ultimate FFA & 1v1 is a comprehensive combat solution for Minecraft servers (Paper). It seamlessly combines a high-action Free-For-All (FFA) mode with a professional 1v1 Duel system, giving your players the best of both worlds.

# **🛡️ FFA (Free-For-All) System**
- Zone Management: Define specific FFA areas where players can battle freely.

- Spawn Protection: Integrated ArenaProtectionListener ensures safety in the spawn area (prevents griefing, block breaking, and damage).

- Automatic Respawn: Fast-paced gameplay with automated respawns and immediate return to combat or spawn status.

# 🤺 **1v1 PvP Duel System**
- Challenges: Send duel requests using /pvp <player>. Players can accept via clickable chat messages or commands.

- Arena Management: Admins can create multiple duel arenas with fixed spawn points (pos1/pos2).

- Kit Selection GUI: The challenger can select the battle equipment through an intuitive GUI before the fight starts.

- Arena Reset: After a duel, the arena automatically resets. Any blocks placed or destroyed during the fight are restored.

# 📦 **Kits & Stats Tracking**
- Predefined Kits: Players automatically receive the correct gear when entering the FFA zone or starting a duel.

- Status Tracking: The system monitors whether a player is at Spawn, in the FFA Zone, or in an Active Duel, adjusting permissions and behavior dynamically.

- Kill/Death Stats: Full tracking of player performance to keep the competition alive.
